あ.hook: Ahh: an acrobat loops around a cross and lands with a flourish.

い.hook: Eee: two eels stand side by side, one a little shorter.

う.hook: Ooh: a hunched figure under a tiny hat clutches their tummy.

え.hook: Eh: a dancer in a feathered hat zigzags and kicks one leg.

お.hook: Oh: a golfer swings past a cross and the ball flies off.

か.hook: Karate: a bent arm chops down and a spark flies off.

き.hook: Key: an old key with two teeth and a curled tip.

く.hook: Coo: a bird opens its pointed beak to coo.

け.hook: Keg: a tall barrel on the left, a tap on the right.

こ.hook: Cozy: two little worms curl up, one above the other.

さ.hook: Samurai: a crossed sword on top, a curved shield below.

し.hook: She dangles a fishhook on one long curving line.

す.hook: Soup: a spoon crosses the bowl, then loops down to slurp.

せ.hook: Sell: a market stall with a long counter and two posts.

そ.hook: Sew: a zigzag stitch runs down the cloth.

た.hook: Taco: a cross-shaped stand beside two flat tacos.

ち.hook: Cheerleader: one arm swings across above a round, bouncing belly.

つ.hook: Tsunami: one big wave curls over.

て.hook: Tent: a long ridge pole that sags down at one end.

と.hook: Toe: a big toe with a splinter jabbed into it.

な.hook: Nana knits: a needle cross, a dash and a tangled loop.

に.hook: Knee: a straight leg beside two bent knee lines.

ぬ.hook: Noodles: crossed chopsticks lift a looping noodle from the bowl.

ね.hook: Net: a pole with a fishing net looped at the end.

の.hook: No: one swirl, like a round no-entry sign.

は.hook: Ha, a hat rack: a tall pole beside a hook and loop.

ひ.hook: Hee hee: a wide, cheeky grin.

ふ.hook: Food: a hungry face puffs out its cheeks on both sides.

へ.hook: Hey, a little hill: up, then gently down again.

ほ.hook: Ho ho: a pole beside a two-rung ladder with a hoop.

ま.hook: Mama's mast: two crossbars and a rope looped at the bottom.

み.hook: Me: a dancer twirls a loop and kicks one leg out.

む.hook: Moo: a cow's face, horn on top, loopy nose, twitching ear.

め.hook: Meh: a droopy eye with a lazy line through its loop.

も.hook: More bait: a fishhook with two worms threaded across it.

や.hook: Yacht: a mast leans while the sail curves and a flag flies.

ゆ.hook: You turn: a road loops back across a straight lane.

よ.hook: Yo-yo: a short bar on a string, a loop dangling below.

ら.hook: Rabbit: one ear up on top of a round tummy.

り.hook: Reeds: two reeds bend by the water, one taller.

る.hook: Roo: a kangaroo bounds down and curls its tail in a loop.

れ.hook: Ray the dancer: a straight pole and one leg kicked high.

ろ.hook: Road: a zigzag road curving round, with no loop at the end.

わ.hook: Wah: a crying baby with a straight back and a round belly.

を.hook: Whoa: a figure trips over a hurdle, arms flailing.

ん.hook: Hmm: a sleepy figure slumps, trailing one long leg.

ア.hook: Ah: a hooked axe swings down to the left.

イ.hook: Easel: a slanted leg leaning on an upright one.

ウ.hook: Ooh: a house with a chimney dot and a sloping roof.

エ.hook: Elevator: a shaft between the top floor and the bottom.

オ.hook: Oh: a tall cross with a cape blowing to the left.

カ.hook: Karate again: the same bent-arm chop, but no spark this time.

キ.hook: Key again: the old key with two teeth, but no curl.

ク.hook: Cuckoo: a clock bird pops out under a slanted roof.

ケ.hook: Keg: a slanted keg with a tap sticking out the side.

コ.hook: Corner: a box with its left side knocked open.

サ.hook: Saw: a long bar with two handles, one hanging lower.

シ.hook: She smiles up: two eyes on the left, a grin sweeping upward.

ス.hook: Sumo: a wrestler bends forward and kicks one leg back.

セ.hook: Sell: the market stall again, now with just one post.

ソ.hook: Sew: a needle dot, then a long stitch falling from the top.

タ.hook: Taco: a folded taco with a little filling tucked inside.

チ.hook: Cheers: a raised glass, slanted top, crossbar and stem.

ツ.hook: Tsunami: three drops of spray crash down from the top.

テ.hook: Telephone pole: two short bars on top, a wire bending down.

ト.hook: Toe: a toe pointing up with its nail jutting out.

ナ.hook: Nail: a nail driven through a crossbar, slanting down.

ニ.hook: Knee: two shins lying flat, the top one shorter.

ヌ.hook: Noodle: a chopstick slices through one bent strand.

ネ.hook: Net: a dotted mast with nets hanging on both sides.

ノ.hook: No: a single slash, like crossing something out.

ハ.hook: Ha: a laughing mouth, two lines spreading wide apart.

ヒ.hook: Heel: a short bar sitting on an L-shaped shoe heel.

フ.hook: Fool's cap: a flat top that folds down to the left.

ヘ.hook: Hey, the little hill again: the same shape in both scripts.

ホ.hook: Ho ho: a cross with two little roots flicked out below.

マ.hook: Martini: a wide rim tipping down to a point.

ミ.hook: Me, me, me: three little dashes stacked downward.

ム.hook: Moo: a cow's snout, a pointed loop with a nostril dash.

メ.hook: Meh: a lazy cross, two strokes marked over each other.

モ.hook: More: two crossbars on a post that hooks right at the bottom.

ヤ.hook: Yacht: a slanted mast against a sail bent like a hook.

ユ.hook: You turn: a bent road sitting on a long base line.

ヨ.hook: Yo: a comb with three teeth pointing to the left.

ラ.hook: Rabbit ears: a short lid on top of a hook swooping down.

リ.hook: Reeds again: two reeds, just straighter than before.

ル.hook: Roots: two roots dangling, the right one flicking up.

レ.hook: Ray on a skate ramp: straight down, then a quick flick up.

ロ.hook: Row: a square rowboat seen from above.

ワ.hook: Wah: a baby's mouth with a flat top lip, open below.

ヲ.hook: Whoa: a wobbly ladder, two rungs leaning on a bent rail.

ン.hook: Hmm: a dot, then a long stroke sweeping up from below.
